; ==========================================

; ==========================================

; ==========================================

; ==========================================
; Function: countPrimes_v1_worker
; ==========================================
; Function Attrs: noinline
define double @countPrimes_v1_worker(ptr %0, ptr %1, ptr %2) #2 {
entry:
  %3 = tail call i1 @rt_check_recursion(ptr %0)
  br i1 %3, label %common.ret, label %rec_ok

  %common.ret.op = phi double [ %4, %rec_ok ], [ 0.000000e+00, %entry ]

  %4 = tail call fast fastcc double @countPrimes_v1_worker_native(double %to_double)
  tail call void @rt_pop_call_depth(ptr %0)
  %5 = getelementptr i8, ptr %1, i64 40

  %6 = getelementptr i8, ptr %1, i64 80

}

; ==========================================

; ==========================================
; Function: countPrimes_v1_worker
; ==========================================

; ==========================================
